title: prunus incisa f. bellura
intro: Prunus incisa f. bellura, commonly known as Japanese fleshy cherry or Bell's rose cherry, is a small deciduous shrub belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including its ability to lower blood pressure and reduce inflammation. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which are said to promote relaxation and reduce stress. Bioactive constituents present in Prunus incisa f. bellura include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
